general.title: L2P Multi-Comparison Pathway Analysis
general.instructions: Compare pathway enrichment across multiple differential expression contrasts using Fisher's exact test. Configure the essential parameters in Basic Settings to get started.

categories.name: Column Overrides (Advanced)
categories.help_text: Advanced: Override auto-detected columns if needed

categories.name: Gene Selection Method
categories.help_text: How to select significant genes for enrichment

categories.name: Axis Customization (Optional)
categories.help_text: Customize axis titles, labels, and font sizes

parameters.name: Input DEG Table
parameters.help_text: Path to differential expression results table (RDS, CSV, or TSV format) containing gene names and statistics for multiple comparisons

parameters.name: Gene Names Column
parameters.help_text: Name of the column containing gene symbols

parameters.name: Comparisons
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated comparison IDs (e.g., 'TreatmentB-Control,TreatmentC-Control'). Column names are derived as <comparison>_tstat, <comparison>_pval, <comparison>_FC

parameters.name: Species
parameters.help_text: Species for ortholog mapping. Non-human genes are converted to human before L2P analysis

parameters.name: Pathway Collections
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated pathway collections: GO, REACTOME, KEGG, H (Hallmark), C1-C8 (MSigDB), WikiPathways

parameters.name: T-Statistic Columns
parameters.help_text: Override auto-detected t-statistic columns. Comma-separated column names (used for ranking genes). Leave blank to use Comparisons parameter

parameters.name: Significance Columns
parameters.help_text: Override auto-detected p-value columns. Comma-separated column names (required if not using rank-based selection). Leave blank to use Comparisons parameter

parameters.name: Fold Change Columns
parameters.help_text: Override auto-detected fold change columns. Comma-separated column names (required if not using rank-based selection). Leave blank to use Comparisons parameter

parameters.name: Select Genes By Rank
parameters.help_text: If TRUE, select genes by t-statistic rank. If FALSE, use p-value and fold change thresholds

parameters.name: Select Top Percentage
parameters.help_text: If TRUE, select top 10% of genes by rank. If FALSE, use 'Number of Top Genes' parameter

parameters.name: Number of Top Genes
parameters.help_text: Number of top-ranked genes to select (used when 'Select Top Percentage' is FALSE)

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.help_text: P-value or adjusted p-value threshold for gene selection (used when 'Select By Rank' is FALSE)

parameters.name: Fold Change Threshold
parameters.help_text: Fold change threshold for gene selection (used when 'Select By Rank' is FALSE). Applied as fold change even if column is log-transformed

parameters.name: Minimum DEG Genes
parameters.help_text: Minimum number of DEG genes required per comparison to proceed with analysis

parameters.name: Top Pathways to Compare
parameters.help_text: Number of top pathways to include in comparison across groups

parameters.name: Minimum Significant Events
parameters.help_text: Minimum number of comparisons where pathway must be significant to be included

parameters.name: Maximum Pathways to Plot
parameters.help_text: Maximum number of pathways to display in the bubble plot (controls plot density)

parameters.name: Update Gene Symbols
parameters.help_text: Update gene symbols to current nomenclature. Original symbols are preserved in output

parameters.name: Bubble Size Metric
parameters.help_text: Metric to determine bubble size: p-value, FDR, or number of gene hits

parameters.name: Bubble Color Metric
parameters.help_text: Metric to determine bubble color gradient

parameters.name: Pathway Label Max Length
parameters.help_text: Maximum character length for pathway names on Y-axis

parameters.name: Pathway Label Font Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for pathway labels on Y-axis (tick labels)

parameters.name: Custom Pathway File
parameters.help_text: Path to custom pathway file (leave blank to use standard collections)

parameters.name: Pathway Name Column
parameters.help_text: Column name containing pathway names in custom file

parameters.name: Gene Symbol Column
parameters.help_text: Column name containing gene symbols in custom file

parameters.name: Use Built-in Gene Universe
parameters.help_text: Use built-in gene universe instead of detected genes from data

parameters.name: Minimum Pathway Hit Count
parameters.help_text: Minimum number of genes required per pathway to be considered

parameters.name: Pathway Size Limit
parameters.help_text: Maximum pathway size (pathways with more genes are excluded)

parameters.name: P-value Limit
parameters.help_text: P-value cutoff for including pathways in results

parameters.name: Use FDR for Significance
parameters.help_text: Use FDR-adjusted p-values for pathway significance instead of raw p-values

parameters.name: Bubble Max Color Value
parameters.help_text: Maximum value for color scale gradient

parameters.name: Pathways to Remove
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated list of pathway names to exclude from plot

parameters.name: Rename Groups
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated new names for comparison groups in plot (must match number of comparisons)

parameters.name: Vertical Line Placement
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated positions (numbers) for vertical separator lines between comparison groups

parameters.name: Use Panel Plot
parameters.help_text: Use panel layout for plot (splits comparisons into separate panels)

parameters.name: Dynamic Pathway Font Size
parameters.help_text: Automatically adjust pathway label font size based on number of pathways

parameters.name: Custom Pathway Order
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated list of pathway names to define custom Y-axis order

parameters.name: Column Spacing
parameters.help_text: Spacing between comparison columns in the plot

parameters.name: X-Axis Title
parameters.help_text: Optional custom title for the x-axis (comparison axis). Leave blank for no title

parameters.name: Y-Axis Title
parameters.help_text: Optional custom title for the y-axis (pathway axis). Leave blank for no title

parameters.name: X-Axis Title Font Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for x-axis title

parameters.name: Y-Axis Title Font Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for y-axis title

parameters.name: X-Axis Tick Font Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for x-axis tick labels (comparison names)

parameters.name: X-Axis Tick Labels
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated custom labels for x-axis ticks (comparison columns). Must match number of comparisons. Leave blank to use original comparison names

parameters.name: Y-Axis Tick Labels
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated custom labels for y-axis ticks (pathways). Must match number of displayed pathways. Leave blank to use pathway names

parameters.name: Output Plot Path
parameters.help_text: File path for output bubble plot

parameters.name: Output Results Path
parameters.help_text: File path for output results table

parameters.name: Plot Width (inches)
parameters.help_text: Width of output plot in inches

parameters.name: Plot Height (inches)
parameters.help_text: Height of output plot in inches
